title: Formation of a N                     <sub>2</sub>                     O                     <sub>5</sub>                     –graphite intercalation compound by ozone treatment of natural graphite
abstract: In this work, for the first time a stage-2 graphite intercalation compound with dinitrogen pentoxide (N                     2                     O                     5                     -GIC) by only ozonation of natural graphite is prepared.
